claim.quote: The difference is a direct measurement of the strangeness contribution to the vector form factors of the proton.

key_value_text.quote: The extracted value is G^s_E + 0.225 G^s_M = 0.039 +- 0.034

name: A4: strange-quark contribution to the proton's form factors at Q^2 = 0.230 (GeV/c)^2

summary.plain: A4's first result: the parity-violating asymmetry in electron-proton scattering, measured for the first time in such an experiment by counting individual electrons. Compared with the Standard Model expectation without strange quarks, it gives a small strange-quark contribution consistent with zero.
summary.technical: A_phys = (-5.44 +- 0.54 stat +- 0.27 sys) x 10^-6 at Q^2 = 0.230 (GeV/c)^2 and theta_e = 30-40 degrees, against A_0 = (-6.30 +- 0.43) x 10^-6 without strangeness, giving G_E^s + 0.225 G_M^s = 0.039 +- 0.034; first parity-violation experiment to count individual scattering events (PbF2 calorimeter, 0.62 sr).

title: Measurement of Strange Quark Contributions to the Nucleon's Form Factors at Q^2=0.230 (GeV/c)^2
why_it_matters: A counting-mode measurement whose systematic effects differ from those of the earlier integrating experiments.
